listing.summary: An eclectic mix of highly accomplished adventurer historians, domain romantics, pre-collapse administrators and admirals pulled from cryosleep and board members of some of the sector's larger salvaging companies, all part of a single faction that (outwardly, at least) is dedicated to the preservation not only of Domain Law, but of Domain Culture.

description:
Domain Historical Society

A maintenance update with various balance changes and graphic/sfx.
Nostalgia Edition excludes any balance changes.

Original Post:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=21954.0

Download Link:
Achi Edition:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GeGBRbwtFxUw66cLT5l0B3MQKBNMTqKS/view?usp=sharing
Nostalgia Edition:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IR_hjdPeNfdFrI8CRa0yxYZAjhHti9rU/view?usp=sharing

An eclectic mix of highly accomplished adventurer historians, domain romantics, pre-collapse administrators and admirals pulled from cryosleep and board members of some of the sector's larger salvaging companies, all part of a single faction that (outwardly, at least) is dedicated to the preservation not only of Domain Law, but of Domain Culture. Using a mix of low tech and midline ships, backed up by an impressive collection of techmined blueprints, the DHS provides modest support to the Hegemony, while retaining most of their forces for exploration into the sector, to discover and protect any domain ruins from the grasp of independent salvagers or, indeed, anyone but themselves.

Major Contributors:

Gwen:
The one mad bastard who made this amazing mod.

Amazingh:
Implementation of all the fancy systems and weapons I pitched to him, and the whole code side of things.

Vayra:
Getting me started with the modding shenanigans, and sharing a couple of scripts.

Other Contributors:

Nia, Yendorc and HELMUTT for spriting advice, without which would have lead to a rather more ugly mod.

Astarat & Puretilt, Techpriest & Belkie, for getting their own mods done and FOMOing me into finally completing something myself.

Szylva, without which, the mod wouldn't exist, since it originated from me pilfering the design cues from a frigate they did and building a whole faction out of it before redoing every single sprite from scratch.

BayunMeng, Rainbow, Scythe for general suggestions

SanFen for Variant suggestions

And everyone else who lurked in the modding section of the starsector discord, shitposting. You're all awful.

changelog.0.97 Achi edition:
fix a bug that paradeFlare using customdata which can null.
adding more variant and vanilla weapons into donhist weapon pool, matches hegemony's arsonal.
'Hegemony Sanctioned Logistics' can now spawns one extra patrol if the market can spawn one
making 'Lady of the Lake' in Avalon working
Sir Norwood and other special characters should now properly showing up
Goemagot now has a station
fix an issue of fishplate having no explosion sfx
gauger now has a flashy vfx to make it more visible, energy onhit effect now become high explosive
 Kilburn: dp 20-->22
chain home: cooldown 3-->7
Eel tin SRM: projectile spd 240->150, rocket mirv damage 160-->200, ammo 6-->4, now firing in 2 round burst, rocket MIRV triggers in closer distance but has tighter spread (making it strike harder than atrop but both easier to intercept and worse hit rate due to how mirv functions)
Heavy Semaphore Scattergun: lower its OP requirement further to 5, DPS 650-->750
Heavy bofors: dph 65-->75, now has a very tiny prox explosion (so does small bofors)
Whister: lower beam dps from 600-->450 (might need further nerf but we'll see)
fishplate: damage nerf to 60 with longer burst, faster turret speed to 40 (lower its potential anti-ship performance but enhance its AA duty)
 Revert Wembley's Ship system Z Pulse Battery back to Parade Burn, revert the description
 headshunt(f): now have two short burst rather than 2 weapon stack together
teacup/teakettle: beamspeed 10000-->5000
 crossing: engagement range 0-->1000, op15-->12
 Picadilly: shield eff 1-->1.2
ticket puncher: ammo 240-->200, projectile HP 300-->220
